lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li3Mn6O7F5 is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 21 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Li and Mn centers each adopting octahedral environments: Li coordinated by three F and three O, and Mn by two F and four O. Oxygen environments include a tetrahedral motif with one F and three Mn neighbors, while F centers coordinate to one Li and one Mn. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Li and Mn octahedra and between tetrahedral O polyhedra.
